doc.title: Sheila Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Middleburgh, New York, May 11, 2002

title: Blues in G at the piano and goodbyes
summary: Rowe plays a blues on piano and Jordan improvises, then they wrap up.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I wondered if I played a Blues on the piano if you would improvise something?
Sure. Absolutely. Can you play it in G? I know you can. So do me a Blues in G. As it is in G. Here’s the top. One-two-three-four—
You’re very welcome. Did ya have a good time? I did. Oh God, all right. Well you must have something on there. You know you don’t have to use it all.
Thanks for coming. Do you want a sandwich or some coffee or tea before you go? No but I have a little turkey.
